title: "CodeMirror Markdown"
subtitle: "with autosave"

---

```{=html}
<style>
  body {
    font-family: sans-serif;
    margin: 2rem;
  }
  #editor-container {
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 600px;
  }
  .cm-editor {
    height: 300px;
  }
  /* Styles for transformed inline elements */
  .cm-rendered-bold {
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #0f172a;
  }
  .cm-rendered-italic {
    font-style: italic;
    color: #334155;
  }
  .cm-rendered-heading {
    font-size: 1.35em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #2563eb;
  }
</style>

<h2>Live Transformed Markdown (With Auto-Save)</h2>
<div id="editor-container"></div>

<!-- Load CodeMirror 6 natively via ESM CDN -->
<script type="module">
  import { EditorView, basicSetup } from "https://esm.sh/codemirror";
  import { markdown } from "https://esm.sh/@codemirror/lang-markdown";
  import { ViewPlugin, MatchDecorator, Decoration } from "https://esm.sh/@codemirror/view";

  const STORAGE_KEY = "cm6_markdown_content";
  const SAVE_DELAY_MS = 500;
  const defaultDoc = "# Live Formatting\n\nTry editing **bold text**, *italic text*, or # Headings!\n\nWhen your cursor is on a formatted word, the raw syntax appears. Move away, and it transforms automatically.";

  const savedDoc = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? defaultDoc;

  // 1. Create decorators for transformed syntax matching
  const boldDecorator = new MatchDecorator({
    regexp: /\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g,
    decoration: (match) =>
      Decoration.replace({
        widget: new (class {
          toDOM() {
            const span = document.createElement("span");
            span.className = "cm-rendered-bold";
            span.textContent = match[1];
            return span;
          }
        })()
      })
  });

  const italicDecorator = new MatchDecorator({
    regexp: /(?<!\*)\*([^*]+)\*(?!\*)/g,
    decoration: (match) =>
      Decoration.replace({
        widget: new (class {
          toDOM() {
            const span = document.createElement("span");
            span.className = "cm-rendered-italic";
            span.textContent = match[1];
            return span;
          }
        })()
      })
  });

  // 2. Build ViewPlugin that skips transformations on the active line
  const liveTransformPlugin = ViewPlugin.fromClass(
    class {
      constructor(view) {
        this.decorations = this.getDecorations(view);
      }

      update(update) {
        if (update.docChanged || update.selectionSet || update.viewportChanged) {
          this.decorations = this.getDecorations(update.view);
        }
      }

      getDecorations(view) {
        const selection = view.state.selection.main;
        const activeLine = view.state.doc.lineAt(selection.head).number;

        // Collect decorations across visible viewport ranges
        let bDeco = boldDecorator.createDeco(view);
        let iDeco = italicDecorator.createDeco(view);

        // Filter out decorations on the line currently being edited
        const activeRange = view.state.doc.line(activeLine);
        
        return bDeco.update({
          filter: (from, to) => to < activeRange.from || from > activeRange.to
        });
      }
    },
    {
      decorations: (v) => v.decorations
    }
  );

  // 3. Debounced Auto-Save
  let saveTimeout;
  const debouncedAutoSave = EditorView.updateListener.of((update) => {
    if (update.docChanged) {
      clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
      saveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, update.state.doc.toString());
      }, SAVE_DELAY_MS);
    }
  });

  // 4. Initialize CodeMirror
  const view = new EditorView({
    doc: savedDoc,
    extensions: [
      basicSetup,
      markdown(),
      liveTransformPlugin,
      debouncedAutoSave
    ],
    parent: document.querySelector("#editor-container")
  });
</script>
```
